runs.text: Place each program in the way of thinking about it that suits it best.

What changes over time and has its own state is well thought of with objects. What transforms data into other data, with functions. A short program that does one thing needs nothing more than orders in a row.
A balance that goes up and down all day.
A game with characters that keep their energy.
Turning a list of sales into a report.
A 10-line program that converts a temperature.
